links.kind: Eighteen original n50/n51 frontier items; original 50-input plan unchanged.

question: Which of the remaining 18 original n50 and n51 frontier inputs yield accepted D3, D4 or D5 certificates under the pinned 16 GiB cascade worker, and does any accepted D5 codimension exceed its fresh solution count?

claims.text: An independently accepted D5 certificate whose checked codimension exceeds the freshly enumerated solution count certifies LFD >=6 for the exact named Boolean presentation.

arms.description: Eighteen original n50/n51 inputs in fixed original order: dense D3 seed and original checker, then native D4/D5 lifts with independent checks; each stops on refusal or inconclusive constant image.
Fresh exhaustive Boolean solution count for each of the same 18 named inputs using count_by_sum.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact deterministic algebra and counts; no runtime comparison. Different chunk sizes are covered by software fixtures.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Before frontier trials, three consecutive D3->D4->D5 software controls passed every original checker and matched direct dense codimensions. A complete driver/count/checker positive control also passed.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Prior malformed-map and allocation controls remain applicable; the complete cascade driver correctly emits no bound when checked codimension equals exact count. Initial four-variable fixture was refused at D5 and retained; corrected controls use at least six variables.

factors.name: input
factors.how: The 18 still-unrun original n50/n51 records from cascade-plan.json after poly00/poly01 terminal outcomes; no new random input, and the original 50-input plan remains unchanged.

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: Driver, native producer, original checker, descent modules and helper source hashes pinned in cascade-plan.json, plus all three binary hashes.

factors.name: host
factors.how: One shared local host, one sequential 16 GiB-capped worker with one thread. Launch after n50 poly01 terminal, exclusive frontier locks, checkpoint reconciliation and MemAvailable >=18 GiB. No timing claim.

factors.name: order
factors.how: Original plan order for all 18 named inputs; per input exact count, D3 seed, then conditional D4/D5 stages. No terminal input is retried.

factors.name: stage
factors.how: Exact count executes first for every input; construction follows when count succeeds. Later lift/checker stages are conditional on the preceding accepted map, not fictitious rectangular arms.

comparisons.threshold: Original checker accepts degree5 and fresh exhaustive count is strictly below checked codimension.

variable_ledger.aa_not_applicable: Deterministic exact certificates and enumeration; no timing comparison.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Exact named-input replay has no arm-dependent clock inference.

seed_derivation.note: No new random inputs; use the 18 selected original frozen parameter records and their recorded seeds.

instance_sampling.rule: All still-unrun original n50/n51 frontier records in original plan order after poly00 and poly01 stopped at D3; adaptive continuation of named inputs, with no population or timing inference.

blinding.how: Exact inputs and prior campaign are visible; no population or timing inference.

power.note: One fixed exact input; no population inference or statistical power claim.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Per-command watchdog multiplied by 18 is a conservative allowance, not a runtime prediction.

primary.name: accepted D5 codimension lower bound
primary.definition: nq only after original independent checker acceptance; absent if no accepted certificate.
primary.source: result.json stages entry at degree5, certified_codimension; absent if no accepted D5 map.

secondary.name: exhaustive Boolean solution count
secondary.definition: Fresh count from the pinned native counter; no copied historical value is a new measurement.

placement.checkpoint_detail: Each of 18 items retains its stage records; native elimination is not checkpointed. Launch only after n50 poly01 terminal and fresh ownership/memory gates. Incomplete items require reconciliation, with no automatic retry.

stopping_rules.rule: Attempt each of the 18 original n50/n51 targets once in original order. Within each stop construction on resource refusal, counter failure, rejected certificate or projection_kills_one; retain all earlier accepted stages and justified lower bounds. Continue to the next fixed item after a terminal result.
Resource refusal, timeout, invalid certificate or counter failure is retained without an LFD inference.

Launch only after n50 poly01 cascade is terminal, prior n49 checkpoint reconciled, exclusive locks and MemAvailable >=18 GiB, and the named panel output root is absent. No concurrent frontier producer.

invalidation_rules: Any source or binary hash mismatch prevents execution.
A failed independent checker prevents a claim from that stage.
A counter failure prevents a solution-count comparison.
Killing1 in an over-approximating quotient is not membership evidence in the true closure.
Missing later stages remain unknown, even if an earlier stage proves a smaller lower bound.

decision_rule.text: At any accepted degree d, exact_count < checked_codimension establishes LFD>=d+1; reaching6 requires an accepted degree5 certificate and this strict inequality.

inputs: generated D3 seed and successively accepted certificates
outputs: Per-item exact counts, stage transcripts, accepted certificates and checker outputs; explicit missing stages and conditional rigorous lower bounds.

graphs: Per-instance D5 outcomes with unknown cells explicit; no runtime graph

inadmissible: Calling a killed constant a proved upper bound.
Calling native output certified before original checker acceptance.
Inferring LFD>=6 without accepted D5 map and strict count inequality.
Replacing original capped dense-engine records with cascade outcomes.
Treating a lower-degree accepted stage as degree-five completion.

literature.claim: Constructive quotient-lift rationale, source review and remaining validation requirements.
